basic_info.description: Charming cottage-style home, featuring a welcoming front porch, restored shingle siding, landscaped front yard, and a level paved backyard perfect for outdoor entertaining. The open main level offers a bright living/kitchen/dining area with engineered floors and a redesigned kitchen with Fisher & Paykel stainless steel appliances and a gas range. The rear primary bedroom opens to a deck with skyline views and includes a large closet/laundry area. A second bedroom off the kitchen and contemporary bathroom completes the main level. Enjoy sunny days and cozy nights by the backyard gas firepit. Easy access to Muni T-Line, 101 & 280. Lower-level bonus space includes similar features as the main level (non-conforming, not legal living space). Ideal as a starter, multi-generational, or investment property!
